title: L’Oréal brings Maybelline virtual try-on to ChatGPT
summary: L'Oréal has announced a strategic collaboration with OpenAI to integrate Maybelline New York's virtual makeup try-on technology directly into ChatGPT. The partnership, revealed at VivaTech 2026, extends beyond consumer-facing shopping tools to include product discovery, advertising pilots, research, and internal content production across L'Oréal's operations.
problem_solved: Enables consumers to realistically preview and try on makeup products virtually before purchasing, eliminating the uncertainty of online beauty shopping.
why_valuable: This partnership bridges the gap between digital retail and in-store experiences, potentially reducing product returns while increasing customer confidence and engagement in online beauty purchases.
